INPUT: raw records R, target schema S, quality rules Q
OUTPUT: accepted records inserted into DB; rejected records in ErrorTable

   - required vs optional field

   - Update the support count in \(\Delta DB\) for every saved frequent itemset \(X\in L_{DB}\).
   - Simultaneously mine frequent itemsets in \(\Delta DB\) using the local threshold \(\text{min\_sup}\times n\), obtaining \(L_{\Delta DB}\) and their supports.

   \[
   C = L_{DB}\cup L_{\Delta DB}.
   \]
   Under a relative support threshold, any globally frequent itemset must be frequent in DB or in \(\Delta DB\); otherwise it would not reach the global threshold.

   \[
   \text{support}_{global}(X)=\text{support}_{DB}(X)+\text{support}_{\Delta DB}(X).

   For each \(Z\in L_{global}\) and each nonempty proper subset \(A\subset Z\), let \(B=Z\setminus A\). Compute
   \[
   confidence(A\Rightarrow B)=
   \frac{\text{support}_{global}(Z)}
        {\text{support}_{global}(A)}.
